title: carbonplan / sai-downscaling
description:
This record archives the code and infrastructure CarbonPlan used to downscale Stratospheric Aerosol Injection (SAI) climate model outputs. The pipeline is scalable and cloud-native, and it implements 2 statistical downscaling methods: Bias-Correction and Spatial-Disaggregation (BCSD) and Quantile Delta Mapping with Spatial Disaggregation (QDMSD).

We apply the pipeline to daily CESM2-WACCM6 and UKESM1-1-LL global climate model (GCM) output from the historical, SSP2-4.5, and G6-1.5K-SAI scenarios, plus a novel CESM2-WACCM6 G6-1.5K-SAI termination-shock run. Both methods are trained on daily ERA5 reanalysis data and produce output on the 0.25° ERA5 grid.

The pipeline runs in 3 cached stages: regridding observations to the GCM grid, fitting quantile-mapping bias correction on the historical period, and applying bias correction and spatial disaggregation to each scenario. Outputs are written as Icechunk stores.

This repository reflects the code used for this specific project. It is not maintained as a general-purpose downscaling tool, so we recommend treating it as a reference to borrow patterns from rather than something to run as-is.

Data access. The downscaled data are published on Source Cooperative (public AWS us-west-2 bucket). Data access utilities and example notebooks are available in sai-downscaling-data-utils. Full documentation is at sai-downscaling.readthedocs.io.
